title: Prime streams and a short feedback key
question: Do the exact executed prime-derived and two-value feedback searches in archived stream_cipher_attack.py provide a distinctive LP2 reading under the source's own score?
reader_question: Could a prime sequence or short feedback key decode these pages?
summary: The full pinned source searches produce many threshold hits, but complete searches on 19 shuffled versions do too. The score does not establish a reading.
finding: On 38 matched LP2 pages, 2,964 prime-stream settings yielded 644 source-threshold hits (19 shuffled-search range 625–702). On three selected pages, all 6,365,529 two-value LFSR settings yielded 38,826 hits (shuffled range 33,694–44,833). The best stream IoC 1.140 was reached or exceeded by 16/19 controls; the best LFSR combined score was reached or exceeded by 11/19.
limitations: The source's IoC/bigram/I-or-A-singleton score is a permissive candidate screen, not a reading test. Nineteen within-page shuffles supply only a coarse descriptive selection control and are not a cipher model. Old source page labels actually select LP2-01–38; the source-defined but uncalled Fibonacci stream and unfinished Berlekamp–Massey reconstruction are excluded. Other generator lengths, feedback clocks and page ranges remain open.
next_steps: Specify a key rule that predicts a longer passage or untouched page before selecting another score peak.

scope.representation: Pinned source Git-object rune text using its exact GP29 alphabet and period/hyphen/bullet/space/newline word separators. Source page_18..55 maps to current LP2-01..38; separate LFSR selection is LP2-28,10,17.
scope.procedure: Run every entry of the source's 26-stream dictionary in three modes over every eligible source page. Run all 29^4 ordered two-value LFSR state/tap tuples in three modes over the three highest-singleton pages, including zero/singular tap cases. Preserve the source IoC, bigram and I/A singleton score and hit thresholds. Repeat the entire selected grids on 19 within-page rune shuffles.
scope.parameters: 2,964 stream page-settings; 6,365,529 LFSR page-settings; source thresholds combined>2 or IoC>1.5 for streams, combined>3 for LFSR; shuffle seed 20261023.
scope.exclusions: Uncalled Fibonacci generator, incomplete Berlekamp–Massey key reconstruction, pages outside source selection, other prime rules, longer/nonlinear feedback or different alphabet/language models.

review.kind: complete corrected-input source grid with source-function parity and selected-search controls
review.reviewer: All 26 generators and 107 zero-inclusive LFSR tuples matched pinned source functions before scoring; planted full-page recovery passed. Independent scalar checks verify all retained winners and a complete shuffled LFSR search.

reproduction.environment: Python 3 with NumPy and Numba. run.py --check repeats the entire search and 19 controls. Optional gate.py and snapshot_inputs.py --source-root PATH --check compare with a checkout of the pinned Wulfic Git revision.

visuals.caption: The manuscript's source-threshold hit counts fall inside the range from 19 complete searches on shuffled page runes.
